svg.aria-label: 依据原投影可见轮廓重绘的 Steam Deck 正面温度图
svg.desc: Visible-region vector redraw of the current Steam Deck orthographic cutaway. Occluded paints removed and same-style opaque regions unioned; transparent paint order retained. No raster tracing, color quantization or contour-detail simplification. Original GLB mesh positions and topology unchanged. Valve Corporation 2022 exterior CAD, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; project internal reconstruction. Source: https://gitlab.steamos.cloud/SteamHardware/SteamDeck
